description: Rolepod Codex hooks. All entries mirror root hooks/*.sh byte-exact (parity-enforced by tests/static/lean-surface.sh; Codex uses the same event names, stdin JSON, and hookSpecificOutput/permissionDecision protocol as Claude — verified against the official hooks reference, 2026-08-05). Codex now exposes SubagentStart/SubagentStop/Stop, so block-subagent-commit (deny) and session-lifecycle (cross-CLI sibling locks) are registered; still Claude-only: cohesion-contract-check (fires on the Agent TOOL call pre-spawn — Codex's SubagentStart is post-spawn and cannot deny) and worktree-guard (apply_patch input shape has no file_path field). Hooks fire natively on Codex >=0.144, default-enabled via [features] hooks = true (the legacy plugin_hooks opt-in flag was removed upstream); plugin-bundled hooks must be trusted by the user before they run.
